data.title: 爱宕 · 巡航舰桥的纯白仪式礼服
data.description: 夕阳沉入重樱海域的落日时分，军舰舰桥玻璃上映照出壮美的晚霞。爱宕身穿一袭纯白而英挺的重樱仪式制服，金色纽扣与肩章在夕照中闪闪发亮。黑色犬耳在海风中警惕轻动，长长的黑发如瀑垂落。她转过身来将指挥刀微收，眼神中尽是作为大姐姐的从容沉稳与对指挥官的无限宠溺。
data.action: standing at ship bridge window during golden sunset, crisp white naval ceremony uniform, black dog ears perked, holding scabbard, doting affectionate smile looking at viewer
data.location: warship observation bridge overlooking golden ocean at dusk
data.lighting: warm golden hour sunbeams pouring through panoramic bridge windows
data.mood: proud naval grace, overwhelming affectionate protection
data.promptProse: Standing by the panoramic bridge windows of a warship at golden sunset, Atago wears a pristine white ceremony uniform. Her black dog ears twitch gently in the sea breeze as she smiles with loving, protective warmth.
data.animaCaption: Atago standing by bridge windows at sunset in a white ceremony uniform with black dog ears.
